description: Deadlines of the stm32n6-demo's threads for zprof's schedulability analysis (serve --deadlines). Only these make the verdict; a periodic thread not listed is analysed against its period for information. release: the object a job starts from (its symbol, or "sleep"), when the thread waits longest on something else. period_us: a loop without one release object; a job is one period of its work. job: the name of the application marks (zprof.h ZPROF_MARK_START/STOP) that delimit its jobs; with period_us, releases are that period.

main.why: One panel refresh at 60 Hz: a frame handed over later is a dropped frame. Its jobs are the frame marks in gfx.c (zprof-integration branch): from one hand-over to the next, idle slots excluded; without them (another firmware), one refresh period of its work

audio_tid.why: One 128-frame block at the DAC's 47.78 kHz: a refill later is an underrun

mic_tid.why: One 128-sample half of the microphone's DMA buffer at the same clock: later, the half is overwritten
